jobs.title: Workday Project Manager
jobs.description:
VirtualResource (VR)
is a boutique consultancy supporting companies to optimise their HR and Workday systems. We strive to be the go-to company that partners with businesses to optimise their HR technology landscape.

Our people are our most important asset

We recognise the need for a committed, skilled and loyal team and strive to create a working environment that is flexible, caring and considerate of all needs.
We attract the best people and reward them appropriately
Staff development and upskilling are core to what we do

What is the role about?

We are looking for an experienced Workday Project Manager
to lead the successful delivery of Workday projects, with a strong focus on Payroll-related implementations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives
. This role combines traditional project management responsibilities with an understanding of payroll processes, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

You will work closely with Workday functional consultants, payroll teams, technical specialists, business stakeholders, and client leadership to manage end-to-end project delivery across the Workday ecosystem.

Responsibilities will include:

Managing multiple Workday projects from initiation through to successful delivery.
Developing and maintaining project plans, timelines, RAID logs, governance documentation, and project reporting.
Leading stakeholder engagement and communications across client and delivery teams.
Coordinating cross-functional teams, including Workday Functional, Payroll, Integration, Data Conversion, Testing, and Change Management resources.
Managing project scope, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalation processes.
Supporting Workday Payroll implementations, optimisations, country rollouts, and payroll-related initiatives.
Facilitating workshops, requirements gathering sessions, project governance forums, and steering committee meetings.
Tracking project progress and ensuring deliverables meet agreed quality standards.
Driving adoption of project management best practices and SDLC methodologies.
Supporting testing, deployment, cutover, change management, and go-live activities.
Building strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal delivery teams to ensure excellent customer outcomes.

Must-Have Skills Required

Proven experience managing Workday projects
as a Project Manager.
Experience delivering Payroll projects
, ideally within Workday Payroll or broader HR/Payroll transformation programmes.
Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple concurrent projects.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience creating and maintaining project documentation, project plans, risk logs, status reports, and governance artefacts.
Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies and SDLC principles.
Ability to manage project risks, dependencies, budgets, and timelines effectively.
Experience working with both technical and functional teams.
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage competing demands.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Other Qualifications / Skills That Would Be Beneficial (Not Mandatory)

Workday Payroll certification or Workday implementation experience.
Experience with global payroll programmes or multi-country payroll deployments.
PMP, Prince2, Agile, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification.
Experience in HRIS, HCM, Finance, Time Tracking, Absence, Benefits, or Integrations projects.
Experience working within a consulting or professional services environment.
Knowledge of payroll legislation, payroll operations, and payroll transformation initiatives.
Experience supporting change management and user adoption activities.
Understanding of data migration, testing, and cutover planning within Workday projects.

As this is a remote role, you can be based anywhere in the UK/ EU and South African region
, so long as you are authorised to work without the need for visa sponsorship now or in t he future.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Toku, we create bespoke cloud communications and customer engagement solutions to reimagine customer experiences for enterprises. We provide an end-to-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets. As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of complex enterprise system integration projects across APAC and global markets, acting as the primary delivery owner for clients, partners, vendors and internal teams. Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen project management standards, mentor less experienced project managers, and drive greater operational maturity as Toku continues to scale internationally. Success in this role depends on combining strong technical understanding with excellent stakeholder management, commercial awareness, sound project governance, and the ability to adapt across different countries, time zones and customer environments.

What you will be doing

Enterprise Project Delivery:
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technical implementation and system integration projects, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards across multiple workstreams.
Project Planning & Governance:
Own integrated project plans covering scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, assumptions, resources, milestones and governance activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Technical Leadership:
Work confidently with solution architects, consultants and engineering teams to understand technical designs, infrastructure, cloud environments and integration approaches, enabling informed delivery decisions and effective issue resolution.
System Integration:
Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements.
Stakeholder Management:
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers, government stakeholders where applicable, internal delivery teams, partners and vendors by providing clear communication, governance and proactive expectation management.
Resource & Delivery Management:
Coordinate project resources across multiple countries and functions, balancing delivery priorities while maintaining visibility of resource utilisation, delivery risks and overall project health using Jira and related project management tools.
RAID Management:
Own project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies by identifying potential delivery challenges early, driving mitigation plans and escalating blockers before they impact project outcomes.
Testing & Go-Live:
Coordinate testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), production readiness and deployment activities with consulting, engineering and client teams to ensure successful implementation and transition into production.
Commercial & Financial Oversight:
Monitor project budgets, effort burn, payment milestones, commercial commitments and change requests, ensuring delivery remains commercially sustainable while providing early visibility of potential impacts.
Project Reporting:
Produce accurate executive-level reporting covering project progress, delivery status, financial health, governance updates, risks, decisions and next steps for both customers and internal leadership.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales and Solution Engineering to provide delivery insights, identify commercial risks, support solution transitions into delivery, and highlight opportunities for additional services or change requests where appropriate.
Continuous Improvement:
Help strengthen project management methodologies, reporting standards, governance frameworks and delivery consistency as Toku scales its global project delivery capability.
Mentoring & Leadership:
Mentor and coach less experienced project managers, promote best practices, and provide senior project leadership across the wider delivery organisation.
Global Delivery:
Successfully manage projects across multiple countries and regions while remaining flexible to collaborate across different time zones and travel internationally when required.
AI & Automation:
Continuously identify opportunities to improve project delivery through AI-powered reporting, workflow automation, Copilot agents and other productivity tools that reduce administrative effort and improve delivery effectiveness.

We'd love to hear from you if you have

Experience:
5–10 years of project or programme management experience delivering complex enterprise technology or system integration projects.
Project Management Certifications:
PMP or PRINCE2 certification is required.
Enterprise Delivery:
Strong experience delivering projects for medium to large enterprise organisations, with exposure to large stakeholder environments and structured delivery methodologies.
Technical Background:
Practical experience managing technical implementations involving system integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms and enterprise software, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions without necessarily being a hands-on engineer.
Project Governance:
Extensive hands-on experience using Jira for project planning, delivery tracking, governance and reporting.
Cloud Technologies:
Experience delivering projects involving cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Contact Centre & Communications Technologies (preferred but not required):
Practical knowledge of CCaaS, CPaaS, CTI, enterprise contact centre architectures and the wider cloud communications industry, including familiarity with major vendors such as Genesys, Avaya and similar platforms.
Enterprise Platforms:
Experience delivering or integrating enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and Salesforce. Familiarity with Remedy/BMC or similar enterprise service management platforms would also be advantageous.
Connectivity & Telecommunications:
Experience within telecommunications, network infrastructure or connectivity-related projects would be highly valued, particularly where enterprise provisioning or carrier integrations have been involved.
CRM & Enterprise Applications:
Experience working with CRM platforms and enterprise business applications across cloud and on-premise environments.
Agile Delivery:
Experience working within Agile software delivery environments and collaborating closely with engineering teams.
IT Understanding:
Good practical understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
AI Productivity:
Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve project delivery, reporting, workflow automation or operational efficiency within day-to-day project management activities.
Industry Experience:
Experience supporting government, public sector or healthcare customers would be advantageous. Experience with Singapore Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) environments would be considered a strong advantage.
Communication:
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead governance discussions and manage complex client relationships.
Working Style:
Comfortable working across international time zones, travelling internationally when required, and adapting to the needs of global enterprise project delivery.
Location:
We are hiring for 2 positions currently: one position in Cairo, Egypt (remote with occasional client site visits) and one position in KL, Malaysia (operating on a flexible hybrid work mode of WFO and occasional WFH). We welcome candidates to apply from either of these locations.

Toku has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Startup and by the Financial Times as one of APAC’s Top 500 High Growth Companies. If you’re looking to be part of a company on a strong growth trajectory while working on meaningful, real-world challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Health & Life Sciences Market Research
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager - Health & Life Sciences Market Research based in the United States.

Join a leading data analytics and advisory environment where market research and strategic insights help shape the future of healthcare and life sciences. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee complex research projects from initial planning and budgeting through execution and final delivery, ensuring high-quality results that meet client expectations. You will collaborate with insights consultants, sales teams, operations specialists, and external vendors to coordinate resources, manage timelines, and maintain financial performance. Acting as a trusted partner to clients, you will provide strategic guidance, resolve challenges, and ensure seamless communication throughout each project. Your expertise in quantitative and qualitative research will help deliver actionable insights across healthcare, pharmaceutical, and life sciences markets. This fully remote opportunity offers competitive compensation, a collaborative culture, and flexibility to support a healthy work-life balance.

Accountabilities

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead the operational, financial, and strategic delivery of market research projects, balancing client needs, internal objectives, and vendor relationships. Your responsibilities will include:

Collaborate with Insights & Consulting and Sales & Strategic Growth teams to prepare proposals, develop cost estimates, and ensure research solutions are accurately scoped and priced.
Manage projects end to end, from initial planning and internal kickoff through fieldwork, milestone management, and final delivery.
Establish and monitor project timelines, budgets, scope, quality standards, and financial margins to ensure successful execution.
Coordinate internal teams, operations departments, centers of excellence, and external vendors to ensure resources and deliverables are aligned with project requirements.
Serve as the primary client-facing contact for sample management, research logistics, project status updates, and delivery coordination.
Communicate project milestones, deadlines, and expectations clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
Proactively identify risks, resolve operational challenges, and recommend practical solutions to maintain project progress and quality.
Lead sample design, sourcing strategies, fieldwork coordination, and budgeting activities for qualitative and quantitative market research.
Ensure compliance and pharmacovigilance requirements are understood, documented, and implemented in accordance with client expectations, internal policies, and applicable regulations.
Maintain strong vendor relationships and oversee partner performance to support efficient, high-quality project delivery.
Provide strategic recommendations to insights teams and contribute to continuous improvement in project management processes.

Requirements

The ideal candidate brings extensive project management experience in life sciences market research, combining strong operational expertise with client relationship management and financial oversight. You should be comfortable managing several complex projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, accountability, and high ethical standards. Key qualifications include:

A bachelor's degree in Business or a related field; an advanced degree is an advantage. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
At least five years of experience managing complex life sciences research projects within a full-service market research agency.
Proven experience in project planning, cost estimation, fieldwork management, timeline coordination, compliance, and budget management, particularly for primary market research.
Experience managing healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences market research projects.
At least three years of experience in a client-facing role, with demonstrated strength in client relationship management.
Advanced proficiency in quantitative research methodologies, including online surveys, and qualitative approaches, including in-depth interviews and online focus groups.
A strong understanding of life sciences terminology, target audiences, therapeutic areas, and research methodologies.
Excellent time management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments concurrently.
Strong attention to detail, self-motivation, professional integrity, and sound judgment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across internal project teams, clients, and external partners.
A collaborative working style and the ability to solve problems proactively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Availability to work primarily during Eastern Time (ET) business hours is preferred.

Benefits

Competitive salary: Annual base salary ranging from $85,000 to $110,000.
Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through major national providers, including domestic partner coverage.
Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with company matching contributions.
Flexible paid time off: Flexible PTO, with employees encouraged to take at least three weeks of vacation.
Paid parental leave: Eight weeks of paid parental leave.
Paid sick leave: Up to eight weeks of paid sick leave.
Company holidays: Twelve paid company holidays annually.
Remote work flexibility: A virtual-first workforce, with remote opportunities across most U.S. states.
Collaborative culture: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on delivering high-quality research and meaningful client outcomes.
Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen project leadership, client advisory, and life sciences market research expertise.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Leid grote internationale automatiseringsprojecten van verkoop tot oplevering bij Eurosort.

EuroSort ontwikkelt en produceert innovatieve sorteersystemen die wereldwijd worden ingezet in de e-commerce, logistiek en distributiesector. Onze systemen zorgen dagelijks voor de verwerking van miljoenen pakketten bij klanten.

Als Project Manager bij EuroSort ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de volledige realisatie van onze internationale klantprojecten. Vanaf de overdracht vanuit Sales tot en met de succesvolle oplevering bij de klant ben jij het centrale aanspreekpunt en eindverantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering.

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen scope, planning, budget en kwaliteit worden uitgevoerd en dat alle interne en externe stakeholders goed op elkaar zijn afgestemd. Je werkt in een technische, internationale omgeving waarin geen project hetzelfde is.

De projecten variëren en kunnen oplopen tot + €5 miljoen en bestaan uit complexe sorteersystemen met meerdere disciplines zoals mechanical engineering, electrical engineering en software (PLC & PC).

Binnen EuroSort werk je in een groeiende organisatie waarin techniek, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken op de manier waarop projecten wereldwijd worden gerealiseerd.

Wat bieden wij

Salaris tussen €5.000 en €6.500 bruto per maand o.b.v. een fulltime werkweek (afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring)
30 vakantiedagen
8% vakantiegeld
Bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 150% van je bruto maandsalaris
Auto van de zaak inclusief tankpas, ook voor privégebruik
Laptop en telefoon (ook privé te gebruiken)
Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling (70% van eigen bijdrage door EuroSort vergoed)
Thuiswerkvergoeding
Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie
Informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en betrokken collega’s

Wat ga je doen

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige projectmanagement van meerdere internationale projecten tegelijkertijd. Je bent de verbindende factor tussen klant, interne organisatie en externe leveranciers en bewaakt de voortgang van begin tot eind.

Je komt terecht in een team van 4 Project Managers onder leiding van de Head of Project Management. Binnen dit team werk je nauw samen met engineers, installatiecoördinatoren, commissioners en HSE-specialisten.

Door de groei van EuroSort is er recent een nieuwe rol ontstaan: Project Lead Engineer. Deze rol neemt een groot deel van de technische coördinatie over, zodat jij als Project Manager je kunt focussen op klant, scope, budget en planning.

Jouw taken:

Leiden en coördineren van het volledige projecttraject van Sales overdracht tot oplevering
Bewaken van scope, planning, budget, risico’s en kwaliteit
Organiseren en leiden van interne en externe project meetings
Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt richting de klant
Bewaken van contractuele afspraken en signaleren van scope changes
Opstellen en beheren van meerwerk- en wijzigingsvoorstellen
Coördineren van installatie- en commissioning activiteiten op locatie
Bewaken van Health & Safety plannen in samenwerking met HSE en installatiecoördinatie
Zorgen voor correcte CE-documentatie en projectdossiers
Zorgdragen voor overdracht naar Service & Support na oplevering
Actief bijdragen aan verbeteringen in het Sales-to-Project proces (V-model)
HBO werk- en denkniveau
Minimaal 5–10 jaar ervaring als Project Manager in technische projecten
Ervaring met klantgerichte projectomgevingen (must)
Technisch inzicht of technische achtergrond (must)
Ervaring met multidisciplinaire engineering teams
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en stakeholdermanagement
Ervaring met budgetbewaking en complexe projectomgevingen
Ervaring in machinebouw of intralogistiek is een pré
Kennis van CE-markering en machine safety is een pré
Bereidheid om internationaal te reizen
Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels (Nederlands is een pré)

Over EuroSort

Bij EuroSort werken we met een groep gedreven techneuten, engineers en projectmensen die graag dingen goed willen maken. Geen lange vergadercultuur, maar gewoon samen oplossen, bouwen en verbeteren.

We zijn een organisatie waar je veel vrijheid krijgt, maar ook verantwoordelijkheid. Dat betekent dat we op je rekenen om eigenaarschap te pakken in je werk en zelf met oplossingen te komen. Tegelijk sta je er nooit alleen voor: de lijnen zijn kort en collega’s helpen elkaar snel verder als dat nodig is.

Wat ons typeert is dat we praktisch ingesteld zijn. We houden van techniek die werkt, niet van ingewikkelde theorie zonder resultaat. Als iets beter kan, dan pakken we dat direct op. Dat maakt de werkomgeving dynamisch en soms ook gewoon lekker direct.

Daarnaast groeien we hard, wat betekent dat processen en rollen zich blijven ontwikkelen. Dat vraagt flexibiliteit, maar geeft ook veel ruimte om invloed te hebben op hoe we dingen met elkaar organiseren.

Bij EuroSort werk je samen met collega’s die trots zijn op wat we maken en die het leuk vinden om iets neer te zetten dat wereldwijd draait.

Il ruolo

Gestirai commesse di manutenzione straordinaria edile su magazzini e uffici logistici da 800 a 70.000 mq, dall'iter autorizzativo alla chiusura dei lavori, garantendo sicurezza di cantiere, compliance normativa e rispetto del budget.

Cosa farai

Gestirai per conto della committenza appalti di manutenzione straordinaria e ristrutturazione edile su immobili logistici, dall'incarico ai progettisti alla chiusura del cantiere.

Presidierai gli obblighi del committente ai sensi del D.Lgs. 81/08, verificando PSC e POS e gestendo le interferenze tra cantiere e operatività dell'inquilino.
Verificherai e archivierai nel sistema informativo la documentazione tecnica di fine lavori, con sopralluoghi di controllo sugli interventi di maggiore rilevanza.

Contesto tecnico

Sistema: magazzini, hub logistici e uffici da 800 a 70.000 mq, eterogenei per standard costruttivi e distribuiti su tutto il territorio nazionale.
Organizzazione: riporto al responsabile del settore edile del reparto Real Estate Industriale, in coordinamento con il Project Manager Impianti.
Normativa di riferimento: Testo Unico dell'Edilizia (DPR 380/2001), D.Lgs. 81/08, DM 3 agosto 2015 per la prevenzione incendi.
Strumenti principali: software CAD e sistema informativo per la gestione di progetti e documentazione tecnica.
Vincoli distintivi: lavori su immobili sempre operativi, con un unico inquilino e una procedura di interfaccia già consolidata.

Chi cerchiamo

Requisiti essenziali
Esperienza consolidata su lavori edili di realizzazione, ristrutturazione o manutenzione straordinaria, maturata come project manager, progettista o direttore lavori, e non limitata a manutenzione ordinaria o gestione di ticket e contratti di servizio.
Esperienza nella gestione di commesse o appalti edili, con coordinamento di progettisti e imprese dall'avvio alla chiusura dei lavori.
Conoscenza dei titoli edilizi (CILA, SCIA, permesso di costruire) e dell'iter autorizzativo di un intervento secondo il Testo Unico dell'Edilizia.
Conoscenza del D.Lgs. 81/08 applicato ai cantieri: obblighi del committente, PSC, POS e gestione delle interferenze.

Requisiti preferenziali
Esperienza diretta nella predisposizione di pratiche edilizie o nella direzione lavori, maturata in studi di progettazione o presso general contractor.
Esperienza su interventi in immobili industriali, logistici o commerciali, incluse le autorizzazioni specifiche di questi contesti (es. AUA).
Familiarità con la prevenzione incendi secondo il DM 3 agosto 2015.

Cosa offriamo

Sede: Bologna, uffici in un edificio storico.
Modalità di lavoro: full on site, 5 giorni in sede.
Trasferte: occasionali, per sopralluoghi a fine cantiere sui lavori più rilevanti o per il coordinamento con l'inquilino.
Pacchetto retributivo: RAL 40–50k€ + buoni pasto 8€/giorno + auto aziendale + PC e telefono aziendali.
Contratto e selezione: tempo indeterminato (valutabile anche partita IVA con prospettiva di assunzione); colloquio in presenza a Bologna, preceduto da un primo step online per chi risiede fuori zona.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
RWS is simplifying the technology landscape that underpins our products and services. This includes migrating customers, workflows and capabilities between core platforms and reducing dependency on certain systems.
We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to lead the end-to-end orchestration of these complex technical migrations.
Working closely with Delivery Leads, Senior Engineers, Product Management and other project team members, you will ensure that the many technical dependencies required for a successful migration are understood, coordinated and delivered as one coherent programme.
You will not own the detailed architecture, but your role is to make sure the whole technical change works together: that interfaces align, data moves correctly, dependencies are sequenced, gaps are surfaced early and every team understands what needs to be true for customers and capabilities to migrate successfully.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex programmes to migrate customers, workflows and capabilities between RWS's core technology platforms.
Build and maintain a clear end-to-end view of the migration, including systems, integrations, data flows, dependencies, sequencing and ownership.
Work with leaders to connect plans across individual teams and workstreams into a coherent end-to-end programme.
Coordinate technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams and technology domains, ensuring individual solutions combine into a functioning overall outcome.
Work closely with senior engineers and architects to drive alignment on APIs, interfaces, data structures, mappings, behaviours and other cross-system contracts.
Identify gaps, conflicting assumptions and unresolved dependencies early and drive them to resolution with the appropriate technical or delivery owners.
Establish clear migration plans, readiness criteria, milestones and decision points covering development, integration, testing, data migration, cutover and transition.
Ensure customer and capability migrations are approached systematically, including understanding migration cohorts, exceptions and technical constraints.
Coordinate end-to-end integration, testing and migration readiness across systems rather than relying solely on component-level completion.
Maintain clear visibility of programme-level risks, dependencies, decisions and actions, escalating where cross-team resolution or leadership intervention is required.
Support Delivery Leads and project teams by providing the cross-workstream technical context needed to sequence and prioritise delivery effectively.
Work with Product and business stakeholders to connect technical migration activity to customer, operational and commercial priorities.
Provide senior stakeholders with a clear view of progress, risks, key decisions and confidence in migration readiness.
Continuously improve the repeatability of migrations, reducing manual coordination and establishing reusable approaches where appropriate.

Skills & Experience

Strong understanding of software delivery, systems integration, APIs, data flows and distributed technology architectures.
Significant experience leading complex technical programmes involving multiple systems, engineering teams and organisational boundaries.
Experience delivering system migrations, platform transformations, major integrations or similarly dependency-heavy technical change.
Able to work at sufficient technical depth to understand detailed cross-system dependencies and challenge ambiguity without needing to be the solution architect.
Strong ability to translate a complex technical landscape into clear plans, dependencies, ownership and decisions.
Comfortable facilitating detailed conversations between engineers where alignment may need to reach API, data-field, workflow or interface level.
Demonstrable experience identifying delivery risks created by gaps between teams and workstreams, not just within individual projects.
Experience working closely with Delivery Leads, engineering leads, architects, product managers and other cross-functional project stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, product, architecture, operations and business teams.
Able to operate effectively in environments where the answer is not initially clear and bring structure without adding unnecessary process.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to communicate technical programme complexity clearly to senior stakeholders.
Outcome-focused and comfortable driving accountability for an end-to-end result across teams without relying on direct line management authority

If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

Delta aktivt i tekniske avklaringer og valg av løsninger.

Delta i testing, feilsøking og verifisering av elektriske systemer og automasjonsløsninger.

Stillingen gir deg en variert arbeidshverdag der du veksler mellom prosjektoppfølging, tekniske problemstillinger, kundedialog og praktisk gjennomføring.
Noe arbeid vil foregå ved våre kontorer, mens andre oppgaver kan kreve oppfølging hos kunder, leverandører eller om bord på fartøy i Norge og utlandet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har teknisk forståelse, liker å ta ansvar og motiveres av å få prosjekter helt i mål. Du trenger ikke å være ekspert på alle systemene våre fra første dag, men du må ha et godt teknisk fundament og være nysgjerrig på hvordan løsningene fungerer i praksis.
Du evner å planlegge og prioritere, samtidig som du kan ta tak i tekniske utfordringer når de oppstår. Du kommuniserer godt med både kunder og kolleger, og du forstår betydningen av å kombinere gode tekniske løsninger med kontroll på tid, kostnader og kvalitet.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

Teknisk utdanning innen elektro, automasjon, elkraft eller tilsvarende, gjerne på bachelor- eller fagskolenivå. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.
Fagbrev som Automatiker, gruppe L eller H er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Erfaring fra tekniske prosjekter, prosjektledelse, prosjektkoordinering eller systemleveranser.
God forståelse for elektriske systemer, automasjon eller andre relevante tekniske fagområder.
Erfaring med teknisk dokumentasjon, testing, feilsøking eller idriftsettelse er en fordel.
Erfaring fra maritim industri er ønskelig, men ikke et krav.
Evne til å forstå tekniske problemstillinger og omsette dem til praktiske løsninger.
Gode IT-kunnskaper og evne til å arbeide strukturert med dokumentasjon og prosjektinformasjon.
Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi tror du vil trives og lykkes hos oss dersom du:
Er strukturert og tar eierskap til oppgavene dine og følger dem opp til de er løst.
Er praktisk anlagt, teknisk nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert.
Trives med å kombinere selvstendig arbeid med tett samarbeid.
Kommuniserer godt og bygger gode relasjoner med kunder og kolleger.
Håndterer endringer og uforutsette utfordringer på en konstruktiv måte.
Motiveres av ansvar, varierte arbeidsoppgaver og muligheten til å påvirke.
Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Hos Green Technologies får du en sentral rolle i et selskap der du kan påvirke både hvordan prosjektene gjennomføres og hvordan vi utvikler oss videre.
Vi tilbyr:

En variert stilling som kombinerer prosjektledelse og teknisk arbeid.
Ansvar for interessante prosjekter innen maritime kraft- og automasjonssystemer.
Et kompetent og engasjert fagmiljø med korte beslutningsveier.
Mulighet til å påvirke tekniske løsninger og arbeidsprosesser.
Tett samarbeid med dyktige kolleger og internasjonale kunder.
Faglige utfordringer og gode muligheter for personlig og profesjonell utvikling gjennom produktopplæring, relevante kurs og praktisk læring i samarbeid med erfarne kolleger.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode forsikringsordninger.

Arbeidssted og reisevirksomhet

Stillingen er fast, med arbeidssted i Egersund eller Ålesund.
Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes i forbindelse med prosjektoppfølging, kundebesøk, testing og idriftsettelse. Reiseomfanget vil variere med prosjektene.

Liker du kombinasjonen av tekniske utfordringer, prosjektansvar og praktisk problemløsning? Ønsker du en rolle der du både kan bruke den tekniske kompetansen din og være med på å drive prosjekter fremover?

jobs.title: ERP Project Manager (Finance & Supply Chain Focus)
jobs.description:
1. MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC 1.1. Quản lý dự án triển khai ERP – Odoo

Lập kế hoạch, điều phối và giám sát các dự án triển khai, nâng cấp và tối ưu hệ thống ERP – Odoo, đảm bảo đáp ứng mục tiêu quản trị và nhu cầu vận hành của doanh nghiệp.
Xây dựng kế hoạch dự án theo từng giai đoạn, bao gồm phạm vi công việc, tiến độ, nguồn lực, ngân sách, mốc triển khai và tiêu chí nghiệm thu.
Phối hợp với các phòng ban khảo sát hiện trạng, phân tích yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và chuyển hóa thành yêu cầu chức năng của hệ thống.
Làm việc với đơn vị tư vấn, nhà cung cấp và đội ngũ nội bộ trong quá trình thiết kế giải pháp, cấu hình hệ thống, tích hợp phân hệ, kiểm thử UAT, chuyển đổi dữ liệu và Go-live.
Theo dõi tiến độ, chất lượng, nguồn lực, chi phí và rủi ro; kịp thời xử lý hoặc đề xuất phương án giải quyết các vấn đề phát sinh.
Báo cáo tình hình triển khai, các vấn đề trọng yếu và đề xuất phương án xử lý cho Ban Giám đốc.

1.2. Quản lý các phân hệ Tài chính – Kế toán và Chuỗi cung ứng

Phối hợp với các phòng ban phân tích, chuẩn hóa và kiểm soát các quy trình nghiệp vụ liên quan đến Tài chính – Kế toán, Bán hàng, Mua hàng, Kho và Chuỗi cung ứng trên hệ thống ERP.
Đảm bảo tính liên kết và nhất quán dữ liệu giữa các nghiệp vụ, đặc biệt các luồng từ mua hàng, nhập kho, xuất kho, bán hàng, công nợ, doanh thu, chi phí, giá vốn đến kế toán và báo cáo tài chính.
Phối hợp với bộ phận Tài chính – Kế toán rà soát yêu cầu về quản lý tiền, công nợ phải thu/phải trả, doanh thu, chi phí, giá vốn, thuế và các báo cáo quản trị liên quan.
Phối hợp với các bộ phận Kinh doanh, Mua hàng, Kho và Chuỗi cung ứng để chuẩn hóa quy trình đặt hàng, mua hàng, quản lý tồn kho, giao nhận, xuất nhập hàng và đối soát dữ liệu.
Đánh giá mức độ đáp ứng của ERP đối với yêu cầu nghiệp vụ; xác định khoảng cách giữa quy trình hiện tại và giải pháp hệ thống, đề xuất phương án cải tiến hoặc cấu hình phù hợp.
Kiểm soát yêu cầu tùy chỉnh và tích hợp giữa các phân hệ nhằm đảm bảo tính chính xác, minh bạch, khả năng truy xuất và hiệu quả vận hành.

1.3. Phân tích nghiệp vụ và chuẩn hóa quy trình

Khảo sát mô hình vận hành hiện tại, làm việc với các trưởng bộ phận và người dùng chủ chốt để xác định nhu cầu quản trị, các điểm nghẽn và cơ hội cải tiến.
Phân tích, chuẩn hóa và xây dựng quy trình nghiệp vụ liên phòng ban trước và trong quá trình triển khai ERP.
Tổng hợp, quản lý và xác nhận các yêu cầu nghiệp vụ; phối hợp xây dựng tài liệu mô tả quy trình, yêu cầu chức năng và tiêu chí nghiệm thu.
Đánh giá tác động của các thay đổi về quy trình và hệ thống đối với hoạt động vận hành, dữ liệu và báo cáo quản trị.
Theo dõi hiệu quả sau triển khai, đề xuất các giải pháp số hóa, tự động hóa và cải tiến quy trình liên tục.

1.4. Quản lý dữ liệu, kiểm thử và nghiệm thu

Phối hợp với các phòng ban xây dựng kế hoạch chuyển đổi dữ liệu từ hệ thống hiện hữu sang ERP, tập trung vào dữ liệu tài chính, hàng hóa, tồn kho, khách hàng, nhà cung cấp và các dữ liệu nghiệp vụ liên quan.
Tổ chức rà soát, chuẩn hóa, làm sạch và đối soát dữ liệu trước và sau chuyển đổi.
Xây dựng kế hoạch kiểm thử, điều phối người dùng thực hiện UAT và đánh giá mức độ đáp ứng của hệ thống đối với quy trình thực tế.
Theo dõi, phân loại và ưu tiên xử lý lỗi; phối hợp với nhà cung cấp và các bộ phận liên quan để đảm bảo chất lượng trước khi nghiệm thu.
Điều phối nghiệm thu theo từng giai đoạn, hỗ trợ Go-live và theo dõi quá trình ổn định hệ thống sau khi đưa vào vận hành.

1.5. Quản lý nhà cung cấp và điều phối các bên liên quan

Làm đầu mối phối hợp giữa Ban Giám đốc, các phòng ban nghiệp vụ, đội ngũ nội bộ và đơn vị tư vấn/triển khai ERP.
Theo dõi cam kết về phạm vi, tiến độ, chất lượng và chi phí của nhà cung cấp; đánh giá kết quả thực hiện theo kế hoạch dự án.
Tổ chức các cuộc họp định kỳ, tổng hợp vấn đề, phân công đầu việc và theo dõi tiến độ thực hiện các action items.
Quản lý yêu cầu thay đổi, kiểm soát các hạng mục phát sinh và trình phê duyệt theo thẩm quyền.
Điều phối nguồn lực, thúc đẩy sự phối hợp liên phòng ban và đảm bảo các bên thống nhất về mục tiêu, trách nhiệm và kết quả bàn giao.

1.6. MIS, báo cáo quản trị và tối ưu vận hành

Phối hợp xây dựng, chuẩn hóa hệ thống báo cáo quản trị và dashboard phục vụ Ban Giám đốc và các phòng ban.
Khai thác dữ liệu từ ERP và các nguồn dữ liệu liên quan để theo dõi tình hình tài chính, hàng hóa, tồn kho, doanh thu, chi phí và hiệu quả vận hành.
Ứng dụng Microsoft 365, Excel, Power Query, Power BI và Power Automate để nâng cao hiệu quả xử lý dữ liệu và tự động hóa báo cáo.
Theo dõi các chỉ số vận hành trước và sau triển khai, đánh giá hiệu quả đầu tư và mức độ ứng dụng hệ thống.
Phối hợp triển khai các sáng kiến chuyển đổi số, cải tiến quy trình và các hệ thống quản trị liên quan theo định hướng của Ban Giám đốc.

2. YÊU CẦU CÔNG VIỆC 2.1. Trình độ và kinh nghiệm

Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên, ưu tiên các chuyên ngành Hệ thống Thông tin Quản lý (MIS), Quản trị Kinh doanh, Tài chính – Kế toán, Quản trị vận hành hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có tối thiểu 05 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc, trong đó ít nhất 02 năm ở vai trò quản lý, giám sát hoặc quản lý dự án.
Có kinh nghiệm tham gia hoặc quản lý các dự án triển khai, vận hành, nâng cấp ERP, hệ thống quản trị doanh nghiệp hoặc các dự án cải tiến quy trình.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm triển khai ERP – Odoo hoặc các hệ thống ERP tương đương.
Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm việc tại doanh nghiệp thương mại, phân phối, sản xuất hoặc các mô hình có quy trình quản lý tài chính, hàng hóa và chuỗi cung ứng tương đương.
Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm điều phối đội dự án, quản lý nhân sự tham gia dự án và làm việc với đơn vị tư vấn/triển khai bên ngoài.

2.2. Kiến thức chuyên môn

Hiểu biết tốt về quy trình Tài chính – Kế toán, bao gồm quản lý tiền, công nợ, doanh thu, chi phí, giá vốn, thuế và báo cáo tài chính.
Nắm vững hoặc có khả năng phân tích các quy trình Bán hàng, Mua hàng, Kho, quản lý hàng hóa và Chuỗi cung ứng.
Có kiến thức về hệ thống ERP, cấu trúc phân hệ, luồng dữ liệu nghiệp vụ và khả năng tích hợp giữa các chức năng.
Hiểu về quản lý dự án, phân tích nghiệp vụ, chuẩn hóa quy trình, chuyển đổi dữ liệu, kiểm thử UAT và quản lý thay đổi.
Có khả năng kết nối yêu cầu nghiệp vụ với giải pháp hệ thống, đánh giá tính phù hợp và đề xuất phương án triển khai hiệu quả.
Có kiến thức về MIS, báo cáo quản trị, dashboard và phân tích dữ liệu là lợi thế.

2.3. Kỹ năng

Kỹ năng lập kế hoạch, tổ chức, điều phối và giám sát dự án.
Kỹ năng phân tích nghiệp vụ, tư duy logic và giải quyết vấn đề.
Kỹ năng quản lý tiến độ, nguồn lực, rủi ro và nhà cung cấp.
Kỹ năng giao tiếp, đàm phán và phối hợp hiệu quả với nhiều phòng ban.
Kỹ năng tổng hợp thông tin, lập báo cáo và trình bày phương án với Ban Giám đốc.
Thành thạo Microsoft Office 365; ưu tiên sử dụng tốt Excel, Power Query, Power BI và Power Automate.
Có tinh thần trách nhiệm, chủ động, quyết đoán, tư duy hệ thống và định hướng kết quả.

3. QUYỀN LỢI Thu nhập cạnh tranh:
Mức lương hấp dẫn theo năng lực; đánh giá hiệu suất 06 tháng/lần; lộ trình phát triển nghề nghiệp rõ ràng; lương tháng 13; thưởng lễ và thưởng theo kết quả kinh doanh, thành tích cá nhân.
Bảo hiểm và phúc lợi:
Tham gia đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định pháp luật; mức lương làm căn cứ đóng bảo hiểm thực hiện theo chính sách Công ty và quy định hiện hành.
Đào tạo và phát triển:
Cơ hội làm việc trực tiếp với Ban lãnh đạo; tham gia các dự án ERP, chuyển đổi số và cải tiến vận hành; được đào tạo, nâng cao năng lực chuyên môn và quản lý dự án.
Môi trường làm việc:

This role emphasizes managing outcomes over timelines by defining successful implementation standards, developing consistent methodologies, and ensuring the team delivers customer value at scale. It serves as a key liaison across multiple functions to align customer expectations with delivered results and evolves in scope alongside organizational growth.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a team of Implementation Managers and Enablement Consultants with a focus on accountability and customer outcomes
Coach team members through feedback and skill development to enhance performance and growth
Establish clear expectations and performance standards for the team
Develop and maintain implementation methodology focused on outcome-driven delivery
Create and update playbooks, frameworks, and escalation guides to improve quality and efficiency
Address delivery risks and complex client issues as an escalation point
Ensure comprehensive documentation of implementation knowledge
Consult with customers to support organizational change during adoption
Engage leadership-level customers to build confidence in the implementation process
Adapt to ambiguity and maintain alignment among customers and internal teams
Identify and resolve root causes of implementation delays
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Customer Success, Product & Engineering, and Sales to ensure smooth transitions and alignment
Represent implementation in leadership discussions on processes and roadmaps
Manage team capacity, resource allocation, and workload
Define and monitor key metrics related to implementation success

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad dataanalys i ett innovativt techbolag på en spännande tillväxtresa? Här får du utforska stora datamängder, identifiera mönster och omvandla komplex data till insikter som bidrar till produktutveckling, bättre kundlösningar och affärsvärde.

Om företaget

Greater Than är ett AI-techbolag som utvecklar teknik för att förstå körbeteenden och deras påverkan på trafiksäkerhet och klimat. Genom att analysera stora mängder mobilitets- och kördata kan bolaget identifiera bland annat körrelaterade risker, olyckssannolikhet och klimatpåverkan.

Greater Than befinner sig på en spännande tillväxtresa där data, teknik och innovation står i centrum. Som en del av ett mindre bolag får du möjlighet att påverka, arbeta nära både tekniken och affären och bidra till att vidareutveckla produkter med stor potential.

Läs mer om Greater Than på deras hemsida: Greater Than

Om rollen

I rollen som Data Analyst ansvarar du för att utforska, analysera och kvalitetssäkra komplexa datamängder för att identifiera mönster, samband och insikter som kan användas i verksamheten. Du arbetar nära utvecklare, data scientists och produktspecialister för att bidra till vidareutvecklingen av Greater Thans produkter och funktioner.

Du samarbetar även med kommersiella funktioner, exempelvis Sales, där dina analyser kan användas i kunddialoger, presentationer och affärscase. En viktig del av rollen är därför att kunna förklara komplexa resultat på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt för personer med olika teknisk bakgrund.

Fokus ligger på att förstå vad data faktiskt visar och hur insikterna kan skapa värde, snarare än traditionell rapportering eller BI. I ett mindre bolag med korta beslutsvägar får du möjlighet att ta initiativ, samarbeta brett och bidra till utvecklingen av både produkter och arbetssätt.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

Utforska stora och komplexa datamängder för att identifiera mönster, trender, samband och avvikelser.
Ta fram relevanta insikter, nyckeltal, jämförelser och benchmarks som kan bidra till produktutveckling och ökat kundvärde.
Samarbeta med Tech och Product för att omsätta analysresultat i produktförbättringar och ny funktionalitet.
Stötta Sales med datadrivna insikter som kan användas i kunddialoger, presentationer och affärscase.
Undersöka, analysera och validera data samt resultat från bolagets AI-baserade produkter.
Visualisera och presentera komplexa analyser på ett tydligt och lättillgängligt sätt.
Kommunicera analytiska insikter till både tekniska och icke-tekniska funktioner och bidra till att resultaten används i praktiken.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt analytiskt driv, ett genuint intresse för data och förmågan att självständigt undersöka komplexa frågeställningar. Du tycker om att hitta samband, förstå vad resultaten innebär och identifiera hur data kan användas för att utveckla produkter och skapa affärsvärde.

Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att förklara komplexa samband på ett begripligt sätt. Eftersom du samarbetar med flera olika funktioner är det viktigt att du kan anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagaren och förmedla varför dina analyser är relevanta, även för personer utan teknisk bakgrund.

Som person är du nyfiken, strukturerad och initiativtagande. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, men uppskattar också nära samarbete och kunskapsutbyte. Du motiveras av att arbeta i ett mindre bolag där du får vara med och påverka, ta ansvar och bidra till en verksamhet i utveckling.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

Erfarenhet av praktiskt dataanalysarbete och av att arbeta med stora eller komplexa datamängder.
Förmåga att självständigt strukturera, analysera och visualisera data med hjälp av relevanta verktyg.
Förståelse för datastrukturer, API och analytisk kod.
Förmåga att identifiera mönster och omvandla analysresultat till tydliga och användbara insikter.
God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att presentera komplexa resultat för olika målgrupper.

Vi värdesätter framför allt din praktiska erfarenhet, analytiska förmåga och förmåga att omsätta
data till insikter. Du behöver inte ha arbetat med ett specifikt programmeringsspråk, verktyg eller inom en viss bransch för att vara aktuell för rollen.

Greater Than erbjuder

Hos Greater Than får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett innovativt AI-techbolag där dataanalys bidrar till utvecklingen av lösningar inom trafiksäkerhet och klimat.

Du blir en del av ett mindre team i tillväxtfas, där du får arbeta nära både teknik, produkt och affär. Här finns möjlighet att påverka hur data används, bidra med nya perspektiv och se hur dina analyser omsätts i konkreta förbättringar. För dig som vill kombinera analytiskt djup med verksamhetsnära samarbete är detta en möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med ett bolag på en spännande tillväxtresa.

Övrig information och ansökan

Omfattning:
Heltid, 100%

Tillsvidareanställning direkt hos Greater Than
Start:
Enligt överenskommelse, gärna så snart som möjligt

jobs.description:
Employment Type: Full Time

Work Setting: In-office
Work Location: San Francisco
Work Hours: Office hours
Find out more here: https://semianalysis.com

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.
We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.
Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.
We also offer three core products:
Industry Models
– we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.
Core Research
– our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.
Consulting and Technical Due Diligence
– We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

We're hiring a Research Analyst to join our Networking coverage team, building and maintaining the AI Networking Model — the industry's leading model on datacenter networking architecture, from scale-up, scale-out and scale-across topologies to optics, switching silicon and interconnect economics. This is a cross-functional role requiring you to liaise with members of technical staff, industry partners and financial clients. You'll turn technical and financial information into research, client deliverables and published content, working full-time in-office alongside a small, fast-moving global team.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain components of the AI Networking Model and Dashboard — covering scale-up/scale-out/scale-across architectures, backplane/midplane and rack designs, and switch/transceiver/connector BOM economics
Track and model the copper-to-optics transition: pluggables vs. CPO, ZR/ZR+ coherent optics, DWDM, ROADMs/AWGs, and emerging technologies like optical circuit switching (OCS — SiPho, MEMs, liquid crystal)
Follow earnings calls and disclosures from networking/optics suppliers (e.g. Arista, Cisco, Coherent, ADI) to update models and write analyst notes on design wins, TAM shifts and technology transitions
Analyze how cost, power, cooling and supply-chain constraints (memory, financing, wafers) interact with networking architecture decisions
Build and maintain three-statement/industry financial models and scenario-based forecasts; prepare research reports, presentations and client deliverables
Represent SemiAnalysis at industry conferences, build primary-source relationships with vendors, hyperscalers and technologists, and channel those conversations back into research

Requirements

0–1 years of experience in equity research, investment banking, the buy-side, start-up or a similarly analytical environment — Prior knowledge in networking/telecom/hardware is nice to have but not required
Multi-disciplinary and independent thinkers with a sense of curiosity and interest in technology. We prefer sharp generalists and a technical background is nice to have but not required.
Proficient in three-statement and industry financial modelling; strong Excel skills essential
Strong research skills — able to synthesize technical and financial information from multiple sources into clear insights
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey complex technical ideas clearly
Familiarity with AI tools, Python or other analytical tools preferred; PowerPoint and Excel proficiency preferred
Comfortable working independently with a globally distributed team, and willing to work full-time in-office. This position is based in San Francisco.

Growth Areas

Deepen coverage into adjacent domains as the model matures — e.g. expanding from switching/optics into power & cooling economics, or from datacenter networking into broader interconnect (PCIe, CXL, UALink) as networking architectures evolve
Build direct source relationships with hyperscalers, ODMs and networking vendors, growing from research support into an independent primary-research voice
Take ownership of specific model components or company coverage (e.g. a named vendor or technology transition) with increasing autonomy over time
Develop client-facing skills — from supporting deliverables to leading briefings and presenting research directly to clients
Opportunity to grow into a senior analyst role and team lead as the Networking coverage team scales

Interested candidates should provide a link to a sample excel model (3FS, LBO, Credit, etc.) and writing sample in your resume
. Feel free to include a link to your Github if you have one as well.

One of the companies we work with at Joppy
is looking for a Lead Data Analyst to lead paid search analytics globally. They’re an international two-sided marketplace with several brands across many markets.

The question you’d own

The company’s brands often bid on the same searches. When they compete for the same customer, did the business actually grow, or did spend just move from one brand to another?
Your job is to answer that with experiments, causal methods and good judgement, and to turn the answers into decisions on millions in paid search spend.

What you’ll do

Prove what’s incremental.
Design and analyze geo-split, channel and multi-brand experiments, and tell the team what really drives growth.
Guide investment.
Model marginal returns, LTV and payback across brands, and help SEM leaders decide where the next euro should go.
Separate signal from attribution.
Reconcile platform data with internal measurement and build the dashboards everyone trusts.
Set the agenda.
Own the SEM analytics roadmap and act as the go-to thought partner for SEM, Finance and Data Science.
Raise the bar.
Mentor analysts and review their SQL and methods. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports, but real influence.

You’ll likely have

6+ years in analytics, with examples of analysis that changed a business decision.
Advanced SQL, plus Python or R for statistical work.
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment design. Bonus if you’ve used causal inference or geo-experiments and can explain where they break.
Comfort leading big analytical projects and presenting to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have (they don’t expect all of these)

Marketing or paid-search analytics (CAC, ROAS, LTV), marketplaces or multi-brand businesses, MMM, dbt.
Paid search experience is not required. If you’re a strong experimentation analyst from product, pricing or growth, they want to hear from you.

Long-term incentive plan (cash payout tied to company performance)
Pension plan + private medical insurance
25 days PTO

Office with snacks, fruit and regular team events

jobs.title: Senior Technical Business Analyst / Solution Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Solution Architect
who can convert business requirements into robust solution designs and defend those designs in front of development, infrastructure, and integration teams. The role owns the technical direction of the solution. This is an active technical leadership role, not a documentation-only position.

You will be expected to question vendor and internal proposals, identify weaknesses before delivery starts, and clearly speak up when a design fails to meet requirements, security standards, or budget constraints. Technical Challenge & Design Assurance

Business Analysis

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture
End-to-End Ownership: Own the end-to-end solution design across application, data, integration, security, and infrastructure layers.
Documentation & Diagrams: Produce detailed architecture documents, data flow diagrams, sequence diagrams, as well as integration and API specifications.
Pattern Selection: Select appropriate architecture patterns and justify choices based on trade-offs, costs, and risks.
Design Reviews: Review designs submitted by developers, vendors, and infrastructure teams; challenge them on feasibility, scalability, performance, security, and supportability.
Integration Testing: Evaluate integration approaches (REST, event-driven, batch, file-based) against failure scenarios, transaction volumes, and system dependencies.
Assumptions Validation: Validate sizing, environment, and hosting assumptions (Dev/SIT/UAT/Production, cloud, and on-premises) alongside infrastructure teams.
Technical Debt & Bottlenecks: Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and single points of failure in existing systems, proposing suitable remediation.
Quality & Compliance Checks: Ensure that delivered work aligns with approved designs and escalate any deviations early.
Requirements Engineering: Elicit and document business, functional, non-functional, and technical requirements (BRD, FRD, TRD, User Stories).
Traceability: Maintain full traceability linking every requirement to a specific design element and test case.
Workshops: Facilitate workshops with business owners to translate business needs into actionable technical deliverables.
Impact Assessment: Support impact assessments regarding scope, effort, and project timelines whenever requirements change.
Single Technical Contact: Serve as the main technical point of contact between business owners, delivery teams, and third-party vendors.
Vendor Evaluations: Review vendor proposals and technical responses against agreed scope and contractual requirements.
Risk Guidance: Advise project and delivery managers on technical risks, dependencies, and decisions requiring escalation

Requirements

Experience

8+ years in enterprise IT, with at least 4 years as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or equivalent role.
Hands-on experience delivering API-led and system integration projects within enterprise or government environments.
Practical background in business analysis, including requirements engineering and stakeholder management.

Technical Skills

API Design: REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON/XML, webhooks, and event-driven patterns.
Integration & Security: Integration platforms, API gateways, and authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth2, SSO, UAE PASS, or similar).
Cloud & Infrastructure: Cloud/infrastructure fundamentals (networking, environments, high availability, DR, and security architecture).
Databases: Relational databases, SQL, and data mapping.
Modeling & Tools: UML, BPMN 2.0, and sequence diagrams using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or Enterprise Architect.
Methodologies: Agile delivery in Jira or Azure DevOps.

Certifications

Mandatory: TOGAF Foundation
Mandatory (At least one): AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or above) OR Azure AZ-305
Preferred: CBAP or PMI-PBA

Languages

Arabic: Native or fluent (required for business and stakeholder communication).
English: Fluent (business and technical).

Expected Behaviors & Mindset

Clear Communication: Ability to explain technical risks to executive leadership/directors and communicate business requirements to engineers in plain language.
Evidence-Based Pushback: Willingness to push back on weak designs using evidence and explicitly state assumptions as assumptions.
Scope Discipline: Clear understanding of the difference between what was requested, what was agreed upon, and what is strictly in scope.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager (TPM)
jobs.description:
About XCures

The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.

xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.

xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.

Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.

Solving impactful problems that make a tangible difference in care delivery and health outcomes
Driving order from ambiguity to enable reliable, high-quality delivery across complex systems
Innovating and scaling processes, tools, and collaboration models for real operational impact

Designing execution systems that make teams faster and more effective

This hybrid role combines product management, technical program facilitation, and product operations to ensure that cross-functional teams can move fast, deliver reliably, and continuously improve. You’ll be the connective tissue between those teams, translating product goals into technical detail, standing up processes that scale, and ensuring high-quality, projectable execution. This is a hands-on role for someone equally comfortable in development working sessions, customer calls, ticketing systems, documentation, and release reviews.

Execution & Delivery

Partner with customer-facing teams to onboard clients, capture requirements, and synthesize feedback into actionable improvements

Discovery & Insights

Develop and support PRDs, success metrics, and instrumentation to measure adoption and performance of tools and features
Establish and maintain monitoring and feedback loops, including dashboards and telemetry for user experience and system health

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor’s degree (technical, healthcare, or data-related field preferred)
3-5+ years in technical product, program, and/or product operations roles in high-growth technology environments
Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from definition to delivery
Experience interfacing with both engineering teams and customer-facing roles
Outstanding (internal and external) communication, organization, and problem-solving abilities
Technical acumen and curiosity (e.g., ability to engage on APIs, data pipelines, cloud infra, AI/ML)
Deep understanding of agile execution and tooling
Comfort defining processes and enforcing quality standards
Strong organizational and systems-thinking mindset, balancing immediate and long-term needs

Preferred

Advanced degree in a relevant field
HealthTech and/or AI background
Enterprise SaaS delivery experience
Deeper technical skillset (e.g., scripting, automation, data analysis/visualization, etc.)
Mission alignment

Location

xCures operates in a distributed, remote-first environment, with occasional travel to company offsites or key meetings throughout the year. Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate must already have authorization to work in the United States. At this time, xCures does not offer sponsorship. All candidate information will be held in confidence and in accordance with EEOC guidelines.

Additional Considerations

We recognize that people bring a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the requirements listed in a job description. Diversity of experience and skills, combined with a shared passion for healthcare, is what drives us to innovate. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. xCures is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

Great work deserves great support. We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to supporting them with a strong, competitive benefits package. Our goal is to be a place where people genuinely want to build their careers, and our benefits are designed to support our team in the ways that matter most.

And more!

We provide an end-to-end approach to help businesses overcome the complexity of digital transformation and deliver mission-critical CX through cloud communication solutions. Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. Headquartered in Singapore, Toku supports customers across APAC and beyond, with a growing footprint across global markets. As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of complex enterprise system integration projects across APAC and global markets, acting as the primary delivery owner for clients, partners, vendors and internal teams. Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen project management standards, mentor less experienced project managers, and drive greater operational maturity as Toku continues to scale internationally. Success in this role depends on combining strong technical understanding with excellent stakeholder management, commercial awareness, sound project governance, and the ability to adapt across different countries, time zones and customer environments.

What you will be doing

Enterprise Project Delivery:
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technical implementation and system integration projects, ensuring solutions are delivered on time, within budget and to agreed quality standards across multiple workstreams.
Project Planning & Governance:
Own integrated project plans covering scope, schedules, budgets, dependencies, assumptions, resources, milestones and governance activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Technical Leadership:
Work confidently with solution architects, consultants and engineering teams to understand technical designs, infrastructure, cloud environments and integration approaches, enabling informed delivery decisions and effective issue resolution.
System Integration:
Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements.

Help strengthen project management methodologies, reporting standards, governance frameworks and delivery consistency as Toku scales its global project delivery capability.
Mentoring & Leadership:
Mentor and coach less experienced project managers, promote best practices, and provide senior project leadership across the wider delivery organisation.
Global Delivery:
Successfully manage projects across multiple countries and regions while remaining flexible to collaborate across different time zones and travel internationally when required.

AI Productivity:

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Leid grote internationale automatiseringsprojecten van verkoop tot oplevering bij Eurosort.

EuroSort ontwikkelt en produceert innovatieve sorteersystemen die wereldwijd worden ingezet in de e-commerce, logistiek en distributiesector. Onze systemen zorgen dagelijks voor de verwerking van miljoenen pakketten bij klanten.

Als Project Manager bij EuroSort ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de volledige realisatie van onze internationale klantprojecten. Vanaf de overdracht vanuit Sales tot en met de succesvolle oplevering bij de klant ben jij het centrale aanspreekpunt en eindverantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering.

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen scope, planning, budget en kwaliteit worden uitgevoerd en dat alle interne en externe stakeholders goed op elkaar zijn afgestemd. Je werkt in een technische, internationale omgeving waarin geen project hetzelfde is.

De projecten variëren en kunnen oplopen tot + €5 miljoen en bestaan uit complexe sorteersystemen met meerdere disciplines zoals mechanical engineering, electrical engineering en software (PLC & PC).

Binnen EuroSort werk je in een groeiende organisatie waarin techniek, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken op de manier waarop projecten wereldwijd worden gerealiseerd.

Wat bieden wij

Salaris tussen €5.000 en €6.500 bruto per maand o.b.v. een fulltime werkweek (afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring)
30 vakantiedagen
8% vakantiegeld
Bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 150% van je bruto maandsalaris
Auto van de zaak inclusief tankpas, ook voor privégebruik
Laptop en telefoon (ook privé te gebruiken)
Aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling (70% van eigen bijdrage door EuroSort vergoed)
Thuiswerkvergoeding
Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie
Informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en betrokken collega’s

Wat ga je doen

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige projectmanagement van meerdere internationale projecten tegelijkertijd. Je bent de verbindende factor tussen klant, interne organisatie en externe leveranciers en bewaakt de voortgang van begin tot eind.

Je komt terecht in een team van 4 Project Managers onder leiding van de Head of Project Management. Binnen dit team werk je nauw samen met engineers, installatiecoördinatoren, commissioners en HSE-specialisten.

Door de groei van EuroSort is er recent een nieuwe rol ontstaan: Project Lead Engineer. Deze rol neemt een groot deel van de technische coördinatie over, zodat jij als Project Manager je kunt focussen op klant, scope, budget en planning.

Jouw taken:

Leiden en coördineren van het volledige projecttraject van Sales overdracht tot oplevering
Bewaken van scope, planning, budget, risico’s en kwaliteit
Organiseren en leiden van interne en externe project meetings
Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt richting de klant
Bewaken van contractuele afspraken en signaleren van scope changes
Opstellen en beheren van meerwerk- en wijzigingsvoorstellen
Coördineren van installatie- en commissioning activiteiten op locatie
Bewaken van Health & Safety plannen in samenwerking met HSE en installatiecoördinatie
Zorgen voor correcte CE-documentatie en projectdossiers
Zorgdragen voor overdracht naar Service & Support na oplevering
Actief bijdragen aan verbeteringen in het Sales-to-Project proces (V-model)
HBO werk- en denkniveau
Minimaal 5–10 jaar ervaring als Project Manager in technische projecten
Ervaring met klantgerichte projectomgevingen (must)
Technisch inzicht of technische achtergrond (must)
Ervaring met multidisciplinaire engineering teams
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en stakeholdermanagement
Ervaring met budgetbewaking en complexe projectomgevingen
Ervaring in machinebouw of intralogistiek is een pré
Kennis van CE-markering en machine safety is een pré
Bereidheid om internationaal te reizen
Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels (Nederlands is een pré)

Over EuroSort

Bij EuroSort werken we met een groep gedreven techneuten, engineers en projectmensen die graag dingen goed willen maken. Geen lange vergadercultuur, maar gewoon samen oplossen, bouwen en verbeteren.

We zijn een organisatie waar je veel vrijheid krijgt, maar ook verantwoordelijkheid. Dat betekent dat we op je rekenen om eigenaarschap te pakken in je werk en zelf met oplossingen te komen. Tegelijk sta je er nooit alleen voor: de lijnen zijn kort en collega’s helpen elkaar snel verder als dat nodig is.

Wat ons typeert is dat we praktisch ingesteld zijn. We houden van techniek die werkt, niet van ingewikkelde theorie zonder resultaat. Als iets beter kan, dan pakken we dat direct op. Dat maakt de werkomgeving dynamisch en soms ook gewoon lekker direct.

Daarnaast groeien we hard, wat betekent dat processen en rollen zich blijven ontwikkelen. Dat vraagt flexibiliteit, maar geeft ook veel ruimte om invloed te hebben op hoe we dingen met elkaar organiseren.

Bij EuroSort werk je samen met collega’s die trots zijn op wat we maken en die het leuk vinden om iets neer te zetten dat wereldwijd draait.

What We're Looking For

Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field.

Our journey is always people first.

Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Scale up, not starting up.

Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully-autonomous cross-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest-standing public robotaxi fleet. We’re driven to scale; we’re moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.

Il ruolo

Gestirai commesse di manutenzione straordinaria edile su magazzini e uffici logistici da 800 a 70.000 mq, dall'iter autorizzativo alla chiusura dei lavori, garantendo sicurezza di cantiere, compliance normativa e rispetto del budget.

Cosa farai

Gestirai per conto della committenza appalti di manutenzione straordinaria e ristrutturazione edile su immobili logistici, dall'incarico ai progettisti alla chiusura del cantiere.

Presidierai gli obblighi del committente ai sensi del D.Lgs. 81/08, verificando PSC e POS e gestendo le interferenze tra cantiere e operatività dell'inquilino.
Verificherai e archivierai nel sistema informativo la documentazione tecnica di fine lavori, con sopralluoghi di controllo sugli interventi di maggiore rilevanza.

Contesto tecnico

Sistema: magazzini, hub logistici e uffici da 800 a 70.000 mq, eterogenei per standard costruttivi e distribuiti su tutto il territorio nazionale.
Organizzazione: riporto al responsabile del settore edile del reparto Real Estate Industriale, in coordinamento con il Project Manager Impianti.
Normativa di riferimento: Testo Unico dell'Edilizia (DPR 380/2001), D.Lgs. 81/08, DM 3 agosto 2015 per la prevenzione incendi.
Strumenti principali: software CAD e sistema informativo per la gestione di progetti e documentazione tecnica.
Vincoli distintivi: lavori su immobili sempre operativi, con un unico inquilino e una procedura di interfaccia già consolidata.

Chi cerchiamo

Requisiti essenziali
Esperienza consolidata su lavori edili di realizzazione, ristrutturazione o manutenzione straordinaria, maturata come project manager, progettista o direttore lavori, e non limitata a manutenzione ordinaria o gestione di ticket e contratti di servizio.
Esperienza nella gestione di commesse o appalti edili, con coordinamento di progettisti e imprese dall'avvio alla chiusura dei lavori.
Conoscenza dei titoli edilizi (CILA, SCIA, permesso di costruire) e dell'iter autorizzativo di un intervento secondo il Testo Unico dell'Edilizia.
Conoscenza del D.Lgs. 81/08 applicato ai cantieri: obblighi del committente, PSC, POS e gestione delle interferenze.

Requisiti preferenziali
Esperienza diretta nella predisposizione di pratiche edilizie o nella direzione lavori, maturata in studi di progettazione o presso general contractor.
Esperienza su interventi in immobili industriali, logistici o commerciali, incluse le autorizzazioni specifiche di questi contesti (es. AUA).
Familiarità con la prevenzione incendi secondo il DM 3 agosto 2015.

Cosa offriamo

Sede: Bologna, uffici in un edificio storico.
Modalità di lavoro: full on site, 5 giorni in sede.
Trasferte: occasionali, per sopralluoghi a fine cantiere sui lavori più rilevanti o per il coordinamento con l'inquilino.
